state.decision_rationale: Accepted as the named deterministic utf8-bytes-div-4-v1 heuristic at file, manifest, and complete-packet levels.

provenance.source_label: Claude Fable feature idea: token accounting
provenance.review_target: Reported 39479-line MKTCTX/3 packet; exact artifact not identified

feedback.verbatim: Add est_tokens= per index entry and section plus a packet total. The consumer budgets in tokens, not bytes.
feedback.normalized_claim: Expose reproducible token-cost estimates at useful aggregation levels, with the tokenizer and counting method identified.

current_behavior: The index reports source bytes and lines, not serialized packet bytes or model tokens.
No tokenizer name, tokenizer version, estimation method, or per-section accounting is declared.
Token counts vary by model and tokenizer and can change even when the packet bytes do not.

proposal.summary: Add optional, explicitly tokenizer-scoped token accounting to sidecars or packet metadata, with exact section preimages and a cheap fallback estimator when requested.
candidate_changes: Declare tokenizer family, version or encoding name, exact-versus-estimated posture, and counting tool version.
Report packet total, control-plane sections, each file body, and optionally symbol and chunk subtotals.
Keep counts out of canonical packet identity unless their tokenizer provenance is itself an input.
Use accounting to enforce and audit budget-selection policies.
non_goals: Do not present one tokenizer's count as universal across models.
Do not confuse source-file tokens with total serialized packet tokens.
Do not require heavyweight tokenization for users who did not request a budget.

questions: Which tokenizers cover the intended consumers and can be distributed hermetically?
Should counts be exact, estimated, or both?
Where can accounting live without recursively changing the packet token total?
risks: Tokenizer drift makes cached counts stale.
Embedding per-record counts adds overhead and creates self-counting complications.
Supporting many tokenizers can bloat the installation.
evidence_needed: Count variance across target model tokenizers.
Runtime and package-size measurements for exact counting.
Designs for sidecar, trailer, and pre-payload accounting without recursion.
